_provenance.method: hand-extracted from the rendered matrix (visual read of every track band, codes cross-checked against data/courses names), 2026-07-16
_provenance.caveat: The matrix titles itself 'EPD CURRICULUM MATRIX 2020-2023 [new calendar]' - it applies to those intakes; newer intakes may differ. Re-verify when EPD publishes a newer matrix.
_provenance.encoding: restricted track electives are all-of; 'N Pillar Electives' / 'N Advanced Pillar Electives' counts come from the matrix term headers; advanced pools merge Term 7+8 columns. Cross-pillar substitution options stay in notes (they replace, not define, the track).
